name: Privately establish what was said about Corvin's academic record
status: Corvin is in the Great Hall after speaking with the Visiting Envoy, who previously warned him about alleged remarks concerning his academic record. The Envoy's warning and the player's report of giggling are not proof of what was said. Corvin has just committed that, as soon as this conversation ends, he will speak to Lady Elinor Ash, Professor Oswin, and Doctor Rowan Ash one by one, asking each what was said about his academic record and hearing each account separately before deciding what to believe. No interviews have happened yet. His motive is to get facts and protect his reputation without starting a public quarrel based on inference. Their current locations are not established here; locate each as needed. Keep the conversations separate, record what each actually says, and do not treat a promise or an allegation as confirmation.
success_criteria: Corvin has separately asked Lady Elinor Ash, Professor Oswin, and Doctor Rowan Ash what was said about his academic record and heard each person's account. Preserve the accounts as distinct claims; do not infer guilt or decide what to believe on Corvin's behalf.
current_goal: Locate and speak with Lady Elinor Ash first. Ask what was said about Corvin's academic record and hear her account; do not treat the allegation as established fact. Then proceed separately to Professor Oswin and Doctor Rowan Ash.
